'''Deechi's office''' was located in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. It was in this office that he was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]].

==History==
After [[Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr's funeral]], [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]] and [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] were drinking when [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] asked them for information about [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr's]] death. Later on, Amidala, Organa, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] returned to the office, where they found the body of Deechi, who had been stabbed to death.
